descriptions.zh:
当有更有效率的东西出现时，一味坚持陈旧、衰老的东西是一个愚蠢的决定。

我们现有的科技水平使得神经植入体能够应用于我们[Root.GetName]的全体国民。我们的公民在四肢和器官被改良型的机械版本替换之后，将会变得更强、更快、更聪明。
descriptions.en:
It is a fool who persists in clinging to a worn, decrepit instrument when a more efficient alternative presents itself.

We now possess the technology to make cybernetic implants available to the population of the [Root.GetName] at large. Our citizens will be stronger, faster and more intelligent as limbs and organs are replaced with improved mechanical versions.

descriptions.zh: 是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的器官和血管并且拥抱不朽了。我们必须为我们的所有人口准备先进的合成替身，然后开始意识传输过程。
descriptions.en: It is time to leave our flawed organic vessels behind and embrace immortality. We must prepare advanced synthetic avatars for our entire population, and then begin the process of consciousness transfers.

descriptions.zh: 如果我们要和被称为“虚境”的灵能领域中的居民交流的话，我们必须释放一股难以想象的巨大灵能能量。一场巨大的降灵会已做好筹备，[Root.Capital.GetName]新建的灵能使密会所里最强大的通灵者们将参与其中。
descriptions.en: If we are to communicate with the denizens of the psychic realm known as the Shroud, we will have to unleash an incredible amount of psionic energy. Preparations have been made for a huge séance involving our most powerful psychics in the newly established Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]上的灵能使集会所正在准备一场盛大的圣餐以探寻一位深居虚境中的实体。
descriptions.en: The Conclave of Telepaths on [Root.Capital.GetName] is preparing a great communion to reach out to an entity that dwells in the Shroud.
